project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 + Supabase
build_system: Next.js 16.4.6 with Turbopack (turbopack.rules configured for Tailwind CSS v4). Path alias @/* → ./src/*. No monorepo.
test_framework: None — no test framework installed. Verification is via npm run build (TypeScript + route validation) and manual smoke testing.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from c:\Users\betya\Desktop\she_hulk\save_haven. A clean build with 0 TypeScript errors and 0 route errors is the pass condition. For UI smoke testing, run `npm run dev` and visit the page in a browser.
snapshot_or_generated_files: .next/dev/types/routes.d.ts is auto-generated by `next dev` / `next build` and provides global PageProps<>, LayoutProps<>, RouteContext<> types. Do not import these — they are globally ambient.
environment_constraints: Windows (PowerShell). The dev server runs on the default port 3000. Do NOT restart the dev server during implementation — run `npm run build` for verification instead. NEVER commit .env.local.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md says this is Next.js 16 with breaking changes — always read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code. params and searchParams are Promises in Next.js 16. proxy.ts is the renamed middleware file. src/proxy.ts must NOT be modified.
key_patterns: 1. params/searchParams MUST be awaited in server components: `const { id } = await params`. 2. Client components use `React.use(params)`. 3. Route handlers: `export async function GET(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> })`. 4. LayoutProps<'/path'> and PageProps<'/path'> are globally available — no import needed. 5. Tailwind v4: `@import 'tailwindcss'` + `@theme inline {}` syntax. 6. Zod v4 installed (zod@4.6.7) — import as `import { z } from 'zod'`, API is backward compatible. 7. `getClaims()` not `getSession()` for session check (matches existing proxy.ts). 8. All DB queries in Server Components / Route Handlers — NEVER in client components. 9. `cacheComponents: true` in next.config.ts — wrap async data in layouts with Suspense.
directory_structure: src/ — all application code. src/app/ — Next.js App Router pages and layouts. src/lib/ — utility libraries (supabase clients in src/lib/supabase/). src/components/ — React components (to be created: ui/, layout/, dashboard/, report/, providers/). src/types/ — TypeScript type definitions (to be created). The route groups (auth) and (dashboard) use parentheses to group routes without affecting URLs.
